task: Task 6 step 3: blob 0 coverage, 2026-07-23 state vs canonical 2026-07-26 state
the_question: The new partition of blob 0 into two planes is better in MEANING (two real surfaces instead of one fit spanning both), but it explains FEWER points: 76,595 against 99,482. Better meaning and worse coverage are different things and the second has to be measured, not assumed away.

point_accounting.note: point counts are NOT the coverage measure. A point count says how many points a plane owns; coverage asks how much PLAN AREA is explained. A facet can own fewer points and still cover the same footprint, if the points it dropped sat on top of area other points already cover.

query_box.method: RAW UTM box on points, cells read from the leveled grid; identical to the 2026-07-23 measurement

blob0_own_cells.method: the same measurement over blob 0's own bounding box from the canonical blob table, not the hand-drawn query box

caveat: The old building_cu2 and the new one are both measured on the same cloud with the same cell size, so any difference between them is a difference in which cells hold >= 2 roof points, which cannot change between runs. A non-zero building delta would mean the two measurements are not over the same region and the comparison is invalid.
